messages:
maria: dropped a very small interaction spec for a 'metric handoff' pattern — when a user pins a version, the row should surface a non-intrusive hint that lets them view that version's metrics inline. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/hand-off-proto
ben: quick read 1: i like the hint approach over forcing pinned-by-default. keeps the catalog stable for other users.
tara: UX Q: what does the hint look like for keyboard users? should it be a hidden link or an exposed button?
diane_a11y: accessibility notes: hint must be focusable with a visible focus ring, use aria-controls to reference the expanded metrics region, and have an aria-label like 'Show pinned metrics for Model Z (v3.7)'. any metric updates should be announced with aria-live='polite' and we should avoid rapid live updates. color: the orange background needs text at #111 or weight increase to reach 4.5:1.
sam_frontend: implementation constraints: badges are rendered inside a virtualized list. per-row heavy DOM (popovers per row) will blow up perf. prefer a route-level override map keyed by row id kept in memory, and a tiny inline button that toggles that route state. the popover can be a portal to minimize layout thrash.
ben: telemetry request to eng-telemetry: can you share how often users pin single rows vs multi-pin? want to size default behavior.
eng-telemetry: summary: single-row pins: 21% of pinned sessions; multi-row pin (compare) flow: 7% of pinned sessions. average compare length when pinned: 2.8 rows. retention: people who view pinned metrics toggle it only 9% of the time.
tara: given that, progressive hint (catalog-first) sounds right. microcopy idea: hint reads 'Pinned active 00View pinned metrics' (keep under 90 chars).
diane_a11y: add to microcopy guidance: include model name and version in the aria-label, e.g. 'Show pinned metrics for Model Z, version 3.7, P95 latency 120 ms'. use numbers spaced '120 ms' not '120ms'.
sam_frontend: dev plan: 1) add per-route override map + actions; 2) inline hint button opens portal popover with two choices (Catalog / Pinned); 3) ensure popover uses menu pattern with role=menu, menuitems keyboard nav; 4) update badge aria-labels and add aria-live region. estimate: 2-3 dev days + 1 a11y review.
maria: concerning multi-pin: proposal: if user multi-selects and opens compare we default to showing each row's pinned metrics in the compare modal (dense layout) and hide inline hints there. keeps modal consistent.
ben: agree. also add logging events: hint_shown, hint_clicked, view_toggled. helps us measure friction.
ci-bot: visual-regression: snapshot for branch metric-handoff -> https://ci.internal/snapshots/15123 (diffs: badge copy size, focus ring)

maria: ok if product/design/eng/a11y give thumbs i'll finalize the spec and add a short PR checklist (figma link + accessibility checklist + telemetry events). any last callouts? :eyes:

ben: :+1: love the progressive hint approach

tara: :+1: please keep the copy concise and include the aria examples

diane_a11y: :+1: with the aria-live and contrast fixes noted

maria: thanks all 1 i'll post the checklist and the updated figma in this thread when finished.
